firstLines: Jules Moreau
behance.net/julesmoreau | jules.moreau@example.com | (503) 555-0177 | Portland, OR
SUMMARY
Brand designer with seven years of identity, packaging and campaign work for food, outdoor and arts
clients. I like small teams, tight briefs and print jobs where the paper matters as much as the screen.
EXPERIENCE
Senior Brand Designer May 2022 – Present
Juniper & Vale Creative Portland, OR
• Lead identity and packaging projects for 10 to 12 clients a year, from first workshop to final files
• Redesigned packaging for a regional coffee roaster across 30 products; the new line was in 200 more
stores within a year
• Set up the studio's shared Figma library, cutting setup time for new projects by about a day
• Mentor two junior designers and run the weekly critique
Graphic Designer Aug 2019 – Apr 2022
Larchpenny Studio Portland, OR
• Designed campaigns, social graphics and print pieces for 20 small businesses and nonprofits
• Handled prepress and press checks for about 40 print jobs a year
• Built animated social templates in After Effects that clients could update themselves
Marketing Design Intern Jun 2018 – Aug 2018
Talus & Tern Outdoor Supply Bend, OR
• Designed in-store signs and email headers for the summer sale season
SELECTED PROJECTS
Rattlebrush Brewing Company | Can labels and taproom signs 2024
• Designed a label system for 14 beers that lets the brewery add new flavors without a designer
Marram Grass Shakespeare Festival | Season identity, freelance 2023
• Posters, program and ticketing graphics for a five-play outdoor season
SKILLS
Design: Figma, Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop
Motion: After Effects, Lottie
Print: Prepress, packaging dielines, press checks
